name: September
title: Where to go on holiday in September
intro: September has more destinations at their best than any other month. The sea is at its warmest in the Mediterranean, the crowds have gone home, and prices fall.
seo_title: Where to go on holiday in September: the best month of the year?

faqs.question: Where is still hot in September?
faqs.answer: The whole Mediterranean: Crete, Kefalonia, Naxos and Milos, Menorca, Corsica, Puglia, Malta and Gozo, Paphos, Croatia and the Turkish coast. The sea is warmer than in June.

faqs.question: Why is September such a good time to travel?
faqs.answer: Schools are back, so beaches and sights are quieter and prices drop, but the weather is still summery. It's ideal for couples, friends, families with children under school age, and anyone who can take time off in term time.

faqs.question: What's good further away in September?
faqs.answer: New York, Boston and Washington, D.C. are warm without the summer humidity. Canada's autumn colours start in Banff and Quebec. Bali, Lombok and Zanzibar are still dry, and the Maasai Mara's migration continues.
